page.layout: One page of text, title page: centred title lines at top, a two-column contents block of short lines in the middle (left column SYLVÆ etc., right column CATO etc.), then centred lines, a woodcut vignette, and the printer's imprint at the foot.

l.i: Omnia ab ipso Auctore in Unum nunc Corpus collecta & recognita.

main_text.l: Accessit IAC. LECTII V. Cl. IONAH. seu poetica paraphrasis ad eum vatem.

page.notes: The contents block is set in two columns: left SYLVÆ, ELEGIÆ, EPITAPHIA, EPIGRAMM., ICONES., EMBLEMATA.; right CATO CENSORIVS., ABRAHAMVS SACRIFICANS., CANTICVM CANTICORVM. Woodcut vignette of trees and figures between the title and imprint, not transcribed. Date in the old numeral form MDXCIX is printed as M. D. XCIX. Some ink spots and foxing are present; the word "seu" and "fea" region at the right of the Ionah line is partly obscured, read as "seu".
